$comment: Unofficial. Derived from https://www.hacs.xyz/docs/publish/start/ (no official schema is published). Do not add a $schema key to hacs.json itself: HACS may reject unknown keys.
title: hacs.json

content_in_root.description: Content lives in the repository root instead of a subdirectory.

zip_release.description: Content is a zip attached to GitHub releases. Requires `filename`. Integrations only.

filename.description: File HACS looks for (plugin, theme, template, python_script, zip_release).

hide_default_branch.description: Do not offer the default branch for download.

homeassistant.description: Minimum Home Assistant version, e.g. 2023.9.0 (append b0 to allow betas).

persistent_directory.description: Path preserved during upgrades. Integrations only.

render_readme.description: Render the README in HACS. Widely used, but not listed in the current docs table.
